description: This file defines a CSharpLanguageGenerator class for generating C# code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting different modes (library, mstest, nunit). It includes methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting code, with internal utilities for formatting objects and code indentation.

classes.name: CSharpLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class for generating C# code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting different modes (library, mstest, nunit).

classes.name: CSharpFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting C# code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates C# code for a given action in context.

methods.name: _generateActionInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate code for specific actions based on mode and action type.

methods.name: _formatPageAlias
methods.description: Formats page alias based on mode and name.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Generates specific C# method call code based on action type.

methods.name: _asLocator
methods.description: Converts a selector into a C# locator string.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for C# tests or standalone scripts.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for standalone C# scripts.

methods.name: generateTestRunnerHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for C# test runners (NUnit or MSTest).

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates footer code, including storage state saving.

methods.name: formatObject
methods.description: Formats JavaScript objects into C# code representations.

methods.name: getEnumName
methods.description: Returns C# enum name for specific string values.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.description: Returns property name for specific object keys.

methods.name: formatContextOptions
methods.description: Formats browser context options into C# code, considering device descriptors.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes and quotes a string for C# code.
